tests.name: test_finds_an_injected_next_night_effect_with_the_right_size
tests.title: Finds an injected next night effect with the right size
tests.doc:
200 synthetic days in which every training-load point lowers the next night's HRV by 0.04 ms.

The analysis must mark load → HRV one night later as robust, estimate about −4 ms per 100 load
points, and must not report the same effect two nights later.

inputs.name: injected_effect
inputs.value: '-0.04 ms HRV per load point, the following night'

tests.name: test_false_alarm_rate_on_pure_noise_stays_near_the_fdr_level
tests.title: False alarm rate on pure noise stays near the fdr level
tests.doc:
On 40 data sets of pure noise, at most 20 % of the runs may report any robust finding.

With Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 about 1 run in 10 is expected; clearly more would mean the
dashboard presents chance as an insight.

inputs.name: data
inputs.value: '200 random days each, no real effect'

tests.name: test_circular_garmin_pairs_are_not_tested
tests.title: Circular garmin pairs are not tested
tests.doc:
Pairs in which Garmin derives one value from the other are not tested.

Sleep score → Training Readiness and stress → Body Battery correlate by construction, so a
finding there would say nothing. Bedtime → readiness is a real question and stays in.

tests.name: test_output_is_valid_json_without_nan
tests.title: Output is valid json without nan
tests.doc: The analysis result is strict JSON: no NaN or Infinity, which the dashboard could not parse.

checks.left: [{'driver': 'training_load', 'driver_label': 'Training load, all activities (Garmin)', 'outcome': 'hrv', 'outcome_labe..._label': 'Training load, all activities (Garmin)', 'outcome': 'sleep_score', 'outcome_label': 'Sleep score', ...}, ...]

tests.name: test_empty_data_gives_a_note
tests.title: Empty data gives a note
tests.doc: No data gives an empty list of findings instead of an error, for new users.

tests.name: test_load_daily_reads_all_three_files
tests.title: Load daily reads all three files
tests.doc:
The daily table combines Garmin days, Garmin activities and Hevy sets.

Bedtime in minutes from midnight (negative before it), activity load summed per day and 0 on
days without activity, hard sets without warm-ups and grip measurements, tonnage in tonnes,
Body Battery falling back to the daily high.

tests.name: test_nutrition_is_tested_against_the_following_night_and_next_training_day
tests.title: Nutrition is tested against the following night and next training day
tests.doc:
Nutrition is paired with the following night and the next day, not with two nights later.

Protein → HRV one night later and calories → strength form the next day are tested; strength
form one day later is labelled as the next day.

tests.name: test_incomplete_and_unlogged_food_days_stay_empty
tests.title: Incomplete and unlogged food days stay empty
tests.doc:
Days without a YAZIO entry and days below 1200 kcal count as missing, not as low intake.

Half-logged days would otherwise look like fasting and distort every nutrition finding.

tests.name: test_parse_finds_readings_anywhere_and_drops_notes
tests.title: Parse finds readings anywhere and drops notes
tests.doc:
Readings from every summary become rows: whole numbers, duplicates removed, notes dropped.

The notes field can hold private text and is never stored. Empty responses give no rows.

tests.name: test_sync_replaces_the_window_in_chunks
tests.title: Sync replaces the window in chunks
tests.doc:
A 100-day sync asks Garmin in chunks of 90 days and replaces the stored window.

A reading deleted in Garmin disappears from the CSV, readings before the window stay.

inputs.name: garmin
inputs.value: 'one reading on 2026-10-29 in the last chunk, nothing else'

tests.name: test_one_row_per_boulder_with_the_rest_that_follows
tests.title: One row per boulder with the rest that follows
tests.doc:
Garmin's splits become one row per boulder, in time order, with the rest that follows it.

Each row has grade, status, seconds on the wall and heart rate; the last boulder has no rest.

tests.name: test_rest_before_the_first_boulder_and_other_split_types_are_ignored
tests.title: Rest before the first boulder and other split types are ignored
tests.doc: A rest before the first boulder and other split types give no rows; no response gives none.

tests.name: test_session_summary_with_self_evaluation
tests.title: Session summary with self evaluation
tests.doc:
One row per session: boulders, completed, attempted, time on the wall and resting, self evaluation.

Garmin stores the perceived effort as 0-100; 70 becomes 7.0 on the usual 1-10 scale.

tests.name: test_missing_self_evaluation_stays_empty
tests.title: Missing self evaluation stays empty
tests.doc: Without a self evaluation, effort and feel stay empty instead of 0; no boulders count as 0.

planned.expr: session["effort"] is None and session["feel"] is None and session["climbs"] == 0

tests.name: test_sync_fetches_new_and_recent_sessions_and_keeps_older_ones
tests.title: Sync fetches new and recent sessions and keeps older ones
tests.doc:
A sync fetches new sessions and those of the last 7 days again, older ones stay as stored.

Grades and the self evaluation can still be edited for a few days, so recent sessions are
replaced; older stored sessions keep their rows, and other activity types are skipped.

tests.name: test_failed_request_keeps_the_stored_session
tests.title: Failed request keeps the stored session
tests.doc: If Garmin fails for a session, its stored rows stay instead of being replaced by nothing.

tests.name: test_load_settings_missing_and_broken
tests.title: Load settings missing and broken
tests.doc:
A missing settings.json, broken JSON or a JSON list give empty settings, so the sync still runs.

Broken JSON is reported as a problem in the sync log.

The source lets the sync warn when it falls back to UTC.

tests.title: Every translated literal has an english entry
tests.doc: Every text the script passes to T("…") has an English entry; otherwise English shows German.

tests.name: test_placeholders_match
tests.title: Placeholders match
tests.doc: German keys and English texts use the same placeholders {0}, {1}, …, so no value goes missing.

tests.name: test_service_worker_has_a_version
tests.title: Service worker has a version
tests.doc: sw.js defines a VERSION; installed apps use it to drop their old copy after an update.

tests.name: test_endpoints_are_parsed_per_day
tests.title: Endpoints are parsed per day
tests.doc:
VO2max, race predictions, Hill Score and Endurance Score become one value per day.

VO2max is rounded to one decimal, race times stay in seconds, days without a value are dropped,
and the Endurance Score combines the weekly averages with today's value.

tests.name: test_status_of_the_primary_device
tests.title: Status of the primary device
tests.doc:
Training status, loads and ACWR come from the primary device; fitness age to one decimal.

The Endurance Score limits are kept for the gauge; a missing load balance stays empty.

tests.name: test_sync_replaces_the_window_and_writes_today
tests.title: Sync replaces the window and writes today
tests.doc:
A 30-day sync replaces the stored window, keeps older rows and writes today's status.

A day Garmin no longer reports is dropped; a failed endpoint (here Hill Score) leaves its
columns empty instead of stopping the sync.

inputs.name: garmin
inputs.value: 'VO2max on 2026-10-22, 5K prediction and status today, Hill Score request fails'

tests.name: test_body_composition_keeps_first_weigh_in_and_converts_grams
tests.title: Body composition keeps first weigh in and converts grams
tests.doc: With two weigh-ins on one day the earliest counts; grams become kilograms, fat mass is derived.

tests.name: test_sleep_times_are_local_across_daylight_saving
tests.title: Sleep times are local across daylight saving
tests.doc: Sleep start and end are stored in local time: UTC+2 in October, UTC+1 in January (Vienna).

tests.name: test_missing_payloads_give_empty_values
tests.title: Missing payloads give empty values
tests.doc: When Garmin returns nothing for sleep, HRV or the daily summary, the values stay empty.

tests.name: test_negative_stress_means_not_enough_data
tests.title: Negative stress means not enough data
tests.doc: Garmin's average stress of −1 means too little data and is stored as empty, not as −1.

tests.name: test_readiness_prefers_the_morning_value
tests.title: Readiness prefers the morning value
tests.doc: Of several Training Readiness values per day, the one after waking up counts.

tests.name: test_activity_units
tests.title: Activity units
tests.doc: Activities in minutes, kilometres (2 decimals), whole metres and beats, load and effect to 0.1.

tests.name: test_activity_without_distance_has_empty_distance
tests.title: Activity without distance has empty distance
tests.doc: A distance of 0 (strength training, bouldering) is stored as empty, so it does not lower averages.

tests.name: test_hevy_dates_use_local_time
tests.title: Hevy dates use local time
tests.doc: A Hevy workout at 22:30 UTC counts for the next day in Vienna (00:30), not the day before.
